title: 15,16-Dihydrotanshinone I, a novel beta-catenin-targeting inhibitor that inhibits its nuclear translocation and reduces downstream CD36 expression in cancer.
authors: Chen, Minting; Chen, Baisen; He, Qianyi; Xiao, Shilin; Li, Baoting; Ye, Yun; Zhang, Hongjie; Wong, Hoi Leong Xavier; Ji, Ying; Su, Tao; Kwan, Hiu Yee
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子DHTS与beta-catenin蛋白结合并抑制其核转位，虽涉及分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Wnt/beta-catenin signaling drives many cancers; however, current inhibition strategies have limitations. Direct beta-catenin inhibitors that block nuclear translocation represent an alternative therapeutic approach. We used colorectal cancer (CRC) as a study model, over 90% of the CRC cases harbor mutations in this pathway. Here, we aim to explore the potential of 15,16-dihydrotanshinone-I (DHTS) as a beta-catenin inhibitor in cancer. METHODS: Molecular docking, biolayer interferometry assay and cellular thermal shift assay were used to examine the binding between DHTS and beta-catenin. Site-directed mutagenesis, in vitro and in vivo studies were used to examine the anti-CRC effects of DHTS following its binding to beta-catenin. RESULTS: We demonstrate, for the first time, that DHTS significantly reduces nuclear beta-catenin levels and transcriptional activity in CRC without affecting beta-catenin protein stability or conformation. DHTS binds to beta-catenin at Ser411. A point mutation at Ser411 disrupts this binding and abolishes the ability of DHTS to suppress nuclear beta-catenin, indicating that Ser411 binding is critical for blocking beta-catenin nuclear translocation. Furthermore, we identify CD36, a transmembrane fatty acid translocase, as a downstream beta-catenin target. DHTS reduces CD36 expression and cellular ATP levels in CRC cells; the reductions are reversed by beta-catenin overexpression or stabilization. In CRC-bearing mouse model, DHTS-loaded PLGA-PEG nanoparticles significantly reduce nuclear beta-catenin and CD36 expressions in tumors and inhibit tumor growth, consistent with the in vitro findings. CONCLUSIONS: Our study not only reveals the importance of Ser411 in beta-catenin function but also paves the path for developing DHTS as a beta-catenin inhibitor for CRC therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：Wnt/β-catenin信号通路驱动多种癌症；然而，当前的抑制策略存在局限性。直接阻断核转位的β-catenin抑制剂代表了一种替代性治疗方法。我们以结直肠癌（CRC）作为研究模型，超过90%的CRC病例在该通路中存在突变。在此，我们旨在探讨15,16-二氢丹参酮-I（DHTS）作为癌症中β-catenin抑制剂的潜力。方法：使用分子对接、生物层干涉法和细胞热位移实验来检测DHTS与β-catenin之间的结合。使用定点突变、体外和体内研究来检验DHTS与β-catenin结合后的抗CRC效果。结果：我们首次证明，DHTS显著降低CRC中核β-catenin水平和转录活性，而不影响β-catenin蛋白稳定性或构象。DHTS在Ser411位点与β-catenin结合。Ser411的点突变破坏了这种结合，并消除了DHTS抑制核β-catenin的能力，表明Ser411结合对于阻断β-catenin核转位至关重要。此外，我们鉴定出CD36（一种跨膜脂肪酸转位酶）作为β-catenin的下游靶标。DHTS降低CRC细胞中CD36表达和细胞ATP水平；这些降低可被β-catenin过表达或稳定化所逆转。在携带CRC的小鼠模型中，负载DHTS的PLGA-PEG纳米颗粒显著降低肿瘤中核β-catenin和CD36的表达，并抑制肿瘤生长，与体外发现一致。结论：我们的研究不仅揭示了Ser411在β-catenin功能中的重要性，也为开发DHTS作为CRC治疗的β-catenin抑制剂铺平了道路。
